messages.subject: Does `cfa(,orthogonal.y=FALSE)`equal to `f1~~f2` ?
parts:
corr_model<-'
f1=~q1+q2+q3
f2=~q4+q4+q6
f3=~q7+q8+q9
#explicity indicate correlation between factors,it's dull to input when you have more than 10 factors
f1~~f2
f1~~f3
f2~~F3
'
res1<-cfa(corr_model,df)


When factors correlated,we know factors are not orthogonal. 
without_corr_model<-'
f1=~q1+q2+q3
f2=~q4+q4+q6
f3=~q7+q8+q9
'
res2<-cfa(without_corr_model,df,orthogonal.y=FALSE)


Does `res1` alway equal to `res2`?

already, I suggest you work through the tutorials on the lavaan
project homepage--it will clear up a lot of these questions.
